headline: Delivered gets its own colour.
notes: Delivered (Cmd-click Approve, Ctrl-click on Windows) is now yellow: the parcel while you hold the key, and the ring when it's done. Approve stays green, so you can tell at a glance which one you pressed
Fixed: when VersionUp opens the help guide, the website or a download, Premiere's permission popup showed a line of text you couldn't read on the dark theme. That line is gone
